source: Appendix B, B.8 Quarterly Re-Identification Checklist (docs/BOOK_TABLES.md)

steps.step: Run discovery and compare tools found with tools inventoried
List pilots past their end date
Confirm every material system has a named owner in post
Check that the version assessed is the version running, for every material system
Update the external context: guidance, enforcement decisions, supplier notices, incidents elsewhere
steps.evidence: Context note mapped to the taxonomy

steps.step: Review the regulatory calendar for the next twelve months
Classify again any system whose use changed; confirm the Article 6(4) records
Confirm that every trigger since last quarter was processed and logged
Review the indicators for each material line: breaches, trends, whether thresholds still fit
Collect each participant's written list of changes before the session
Run the focused SWIFT session with the change prompts
Re-assess the material lines on fresh evidence and record the reason for any change
Review data quality ratings; lower any that rest on evidence about an earlier version
Test the assumption register against current evidence
Reconcile with the bottom-up submissions and update the disagreement log
Update the register: new lines, escalations, retired lines (retire with a reason, never delete)
Update the inputs to the board report and the Statement of Applicability if controls changed
Obtain sign-off from the accountable executive and fix the date of the next run
